text: Ravel 1.0 umbrella completed. All phase epics P0-P5 are closed, all 37 PRD requirements are allocated and implemented, OPEN-001 through OPEN-003 are resolved in PRD.json, and GATE-001 through GATE-004 have executable evidence. Final local gate: testAllFull plus representationProof passed warning-fatal compilation, 75 JVM tests, 77 Node tests, reusable Discipline/law suites on both platforms, 3 real-Chromium tests, and optimized Scala.js links. Generated ScalaCheck properties cover shapes, composed views, broadcasts, and mutable locality. JMH/Node baselines and allocation budgets are checked in. Artifact POM/jar scope was audited. The sibling Gale copy-only adapter passed 4 JVM and 4 Scala.js tests. Remaining audit follow-ups—formatting automation, diagnostic coverage, and MiMa after the first 1.0 publication—are recorded as post-implementation assurance improvements, not unmet PRD requirements. Ravel workspace has no .git metadata; Gale changes remain uncommitted because commit/publish was not requested.
